subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.**

The storm uprooted a large number of trees yesterday.

options.text: Large number of trees were uprooted by the storm yesterday.
A large number of trees had been uprooted by the storm yesterday.
Trees was uprooted yesterday in a large number by the storm.
A large number of trees were uprooted by the storm yesterday.

solution:
The correct answer is **"A large number of trees were uprooted by the storm yesterday."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'storm'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'a large number of trees'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'Uprooted' will be changed into 'was uprooted'. 
 
• "A large number of trees" is treated a unit and we must use "was" with it.
 
• The preposition "by" is used to indicate the doer of the action in the passive voice.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.

 ​

Correct sentence: *A large number of trees were uprooted by the storm yesterday.*

3d:T
